goal: Add a GET /health endpoint that returns HTTP 200 with a JSON body indicating the service is healthy.
scope_summary: Register a GET /health route in the existing Express app factory (src/app.ts) that responds with 200 and a JSON object like {"status":"healthy"}. Add a new test file tests/health.test.ts using supertest and vitest to verify the status code and response body.
planned_changes: Add GET /health route to the Express app in src/app.ts returning 200 with JSON {"status":"healthy"}
Create tests/health.test.ts with two tests: one asserting 200 status, one asserting JSON body contains a health status field
acceptance_checks: Response body is JSON with a field indicating the service is healthy
Unit test: health.test.ts > 'GET /health returns 200' verifies status code
Unit test: health.test.ts > 'GET /health returns JSON health status' verifies body
commit_message: feat(F002): add GET /health endpoint returning 200 with JSON health status
risks: supertest must be used with the app instance from createApp(), not a running server, to avoid port conflicts in tests
The health route must be registered before the app is returned from createApp() so tests and production both see it
